name: Physical Bank Registry
description: Register physical memory banks on disk with schema, location, and ownership metadata. Each bank is backed by a JSON file on disk with a defined schema for content, metadata, and access control.
purpose: Provide persistent, on-disk storage for memory banks with well-defined schema, discoverable locations, and verifiable ownership — ensuring memories survive process restarts and machine reboots.
acceptanceCriteria: Bank registry is stored on disk with a defined schema
Each bank has a unique location path on disk
Ownership metadata (user/scoping entity) is recorded per bank
Registry supports create, read, delete operations
Registry is discoverable — listing all registered banks is supported
Schema validation is performed on read and write
recovery_strategy: Rebuild registry by scanning bank directory
